smart_forms.name_en: Credit card purchase abroad without import

Any chemical for laboratory — including DDW40 (deionized water)
Physical import of items from abroad to Israel

ספק חו"ל באנגלית (או GENERAL אם לא במערכת)
כתובת מייל של ספק / איש קשר
smart_forms.key_change_from_brnet: Only the requester edits — buyer no longer edits on requester's behalf

smart_forms.use_case: Physical shipment from Israel to abroad
additional_fields_he: מי משלם על המשלוח (שולח / מקבל / חצי-חצי)
smart_forms.post_creation: Email with instructions + export bill template will be sent to requester

smart_forms.warehouse_name: מחסן כללי (was: המחסן המרכזי in Brnet)
smart_forms.forbidden: Do NOT mark 'תשומת מחקר' — no warehouse item is a research input
smart_forms.process: Becomes Internal Transfer; no buyer involvement

smart_forms.use_case: Internal services from BIRA (851) or BINO sub-departments (900-994)
Payments that are not purchase of goods/services
examples: Scholarship payments (number field 'מספר מלגה' in header)

smart_forms.name_en: Credit card purchase domestic without import
smart_forms.use_case: Local purchase by credit card instead of regular quote-based flow
Purchase from supplier site with shopping cart (not foreign, with shipping)
mandatory_fields_he: צילום מסך של עגלת הקניות (mandatory attachment)
smart_forms.process: Buyer logs in to cart and completes purchase

general_rules_for_all_forms: Always: choose attribute value after adding to cart
Always: valid mobile phone of recipient
Always: attach quote/Proforma per quote-thresholds rules
Always: separate row per item (no bundling)
Requester's responsibility: verify the requisition moved to approval cycle after 10 minutes
